edges.reason: Constructor parameter _liquidityAsset is stored into the immutable liquidityAsset state variable.
Constructor parameter _loan is stored into the immutable loan state variable.
msg.sender is the value tested by the isLoan modifier before either guarded function executes.
msg.sender is compared with the immutable loan address to authorise callers.
The isLoan modifier gates execution of pull.
The isLoan modifier gates execution of drain.
pull recipient parameter flows into the outbound safeTransfer operation.
pull amount parameter flows into the outbound safeTransfer operation.
pull executes the outbound safeTransfer of the liquidity asset.
drain executes the outbound safeTransfer of the entire locker balance.
The cached balance local is the amount transferred by drain.
The loan address is the transfer destination used by drain.
pull delegates the token movement to SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
drain delegates the token movement to SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
safeTransfer builds calldata and calls _callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom builds calldata and calls _callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove builds calldata and calls _callOptionalReturn.
safeIncreaseAllowance approves the recomputed allowance via _callOptionalReturn.
safeDecreaseAllowance approves the recomputed allowance via _callOptionalReturn.
_callOptionalReturn performs the token interaction through Address.functionCall.
functionCall forwards to functionCallWithValue with zero value.
functionCallWithValue executes the low-level target.call{value}(data).
functionCallWithValue hands the raw call result to _verifyCallResult for revert bubbling.
The token parameter is the call target of the external ERC20 operation.
The encoded call data parameter drives the external ERC20 operation.
The optional return data of the token call is decoded to validate success.
sendValue forwards all remaining gas to an arbitrary recipient via call, allowing state re-entry before the balance check takes effect for the caller.
The payable recipient parameter is the target of the value call.
The amount parameter is the wei value forwarded by the value call.
The success flag of the value call is required to be true.
functionStaticCall invokes an external contract through staticcall, returning data that must be validated.
newLocker deploys a FundingLocker by invoking its constructor.
The liquidityAsset argument of newLocker is passed into the FundingLocker constructor.
msg.sender at the factory is used as the loan/owner identity for the newly created locker.
owner[fundingLocker] is written with the untrusted msg.sender, granting ownership.
isLocker[fundingLocker] is flagged true for the created locker.
The freshly deployed FundingLocker address is the key of the owner mapping entry.
First addend participates in c = a + b, which is guarded by an overflow require.
Second addend participates in c = a + b, which is guarded by an overflow require.
SafeMath.add returns the checked sum local, protecting callers from overflow.
